subject: GCP marketplace onboarding ops runway & procurement path for NimbleAI
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: GCP marketplace onboarding ops runway & procurement path for NimbleAI

Team —

Following our partner kickoff last week with NimbleAI, they asked for a compact, ops-friendly onboarding path focused on procurement timing and co-sell readiness on GCP. I attached a working vendor intake and a condensed onboarding checklist (attachment stubs below). Goal: define the procurement handoffs and expected SLAs so we can present a single-page runbook to Nimble by EOW.

Ask: can each of you own the sections below and reply with any blockers?

- Lauren: legal / contract gating items and expected review timeframes.
- Jonas: GCP listing steps + co-sell enablement checklist (what Google needs vs what we provide).
- Kim: billing/sku mapping and procurement intake — what does the finance team need to generate a PO / commit?

Attachments referenced: [nimbleai_vendor-intake.pdf (form)] [gcp_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks — I’ll coordinate a 30-min sync with Rajesh (GCP PM) once we have internal alignment.

Marcus Lin
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0128

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace onboarding ops runway & procurement path for NimbleAI

Thanks Marcus — quick notes from Legal:

- Standard Redwood Marketplace SOW + Terms are fine; NimbleAI asked for a data residency clause for EU customers. We can provide a standard addendum but need to confirm which regions Nimble plans to target.
- Lead time: expect 7 business days for final SOW redline if we do an initial internal review first; if Nimble pushes through their counsels we should expect 10–15 business days.
- Action: I’ll draft a 1-page contract summary for Nimble that highlights the minimal redline surface.

Small ask for the onboarding checklist: please add a column for "legal gating" (I added a comment in the spreadsheet).

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Legal Ops — Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: rpatel@google.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace onboarding ops runway & procurement path for NimbleAI

Looping Rajesh here for visibility on GCP-side timing. Quick outline of our recommended listing + co-sell path:

1) Listing prep (2–3 business days internal): product metadata, price tiers, container/VM images (if applicable), support contacts.
2) Marketplace onboarding (GCP review window): typically 5–7 business days if all artifacts are complete; longer if legal/compliance docs missing.
3) Co-sell enablement (parallel): joint sales deck, case study, contact mapping. GCP expects a primary POC + technical contact from the ISV.

From experience: the procurement path most customers take is — vendor intake -> procurement review -> PO -> listing activation. The sticky part is finance SKU mapping (Kim will own) and whether Nimble needs custom pricing (that will add 7–10 business days).

Jonas Weber
Partner Solutions — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Rajesh Patel <rpatel@google.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: amy.choudhury@nimble.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace onboarding ops runway & procurement path for NimbleAI

Thanks for the outline — Rajesh from GCP Marketplace here. A couple of clarifications from the Google side:

- Legal/Compliance: we require proof of SOC 2 type II or equivalent for co-sell eligibility. If NimbleAI doesn't have SOC 2 yet, we can accept an ongoing audit timeline plus compensating controls for the listing, but co-sell will be delayed until attestation is complete.
- Billing integration: we use SKU mapping provided by the ISV + a standard billing manifest. We'll need a sample invoice and the vendor tax ID.
- Timeline: if the intake form is complete and SOC 2 evidence is provided, the fastest path to listing + initial co-sell enablement is ~10 business days. If any docs are missing, plan for 3–4 weeks.

Next step: can NimbleAI fill out the vendor intake and upload SOC 2 evidence to the shared Drive link? I copied Amy to coordinate.

Best,
Rajesh Patel
GCP Marketplace Partnerships

From: Amy Choudhury <amy.choudhury@nimble.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace onboarding ops runway & procurement path for NimbleAI

Hi all — thanks for the clear runbook. Quick status update from Nimble:

- Vendor intake: completed this morning and uploaded to the Drive link (nimbleai_vendor-intake.pdf).
- SOC 2: currently in finalization, expected attestation by 2027-08-05; they attached a redacted interim report to the intake.
- Procurement timeline: our procurement says PO / purchase can be issued within 7–10 business days after SOW sign (they require the vendor tax ID + sample invoice). We do not need custom pricing for MVP.

Question for Redwood: can we get a single-page procurement checklist (items the Nimble procurement team must provide) so we can share internally and get the PO moving? If possible, also include the expected contact for Redwood billing so paperwork goes to the right place.

Amy Choudhury
Head of Partnerships, NimbleAI
amy.choudhury@nimble.ai
